4: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("UserTakesTargetItem",
5:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
6:     next score if user.wild? || user.item
7:     next score if !target.item || target.battler.unlosableItem?(target.item)
8:     next score if user.battler.unlosableItem?(target.item)
9:     next score if target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0
10:     next score if target.has_active_ability?(:STICKYHOLD) && !battle.moldBreaker
11:     # User can steal the target's item; score it
12:     user_item_preference = user.wants_item?(target.item_id)
13:     user_no_item_preference = user.wants_item?(:NONE)
14:     user_diff = user_item_preference - user_no_item_preference
15:     user_diff = 0 if !user.item_active?
16:     target_item_preference = target.wants_item?(target.item_id)
17:     target_no_item_preference = target.wants_item?(:NONE)
18:     target_diff = target_no_item_preference - target_item_preference
19:     target_diff = 0 if !target.item_active?
20:     score += user_diff * 4
21:     score -= target_diff * 4
22:     next score
23:   }
24: )

55: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureAgainstTargetCheck.add("UserTargetSwapItems",
56:   proc { |move, user, target, ai, battle|
57:     next true if user.wild?
58:     next true if !user.item && !target.item
59:     next true if user.battler.unlosableItem?(user.item) || user.battler.unlosableItem?(target.item)
60:     next true if target.battler.unlosableItem?(target.item) || target.battler.unlosableItem?(user.item)
61:     next true if target.has_active_ability?(:STICKYHOLD) && !battle.moldBreaker
62:     next false
63:   }
64: )
65: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("UserTargetSwapItems",
66:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
67:     user_new_item_preference = user.wants_item?(target.item_id)
68:     user_old_item_preference = user.wants_item?(user.item_id)
69:     user_diff = user_new_item_preference - user_old_item_preference
70:     user_diff = 0 if !user.item_active?
71:     target_new_item_preference = target.wants_item?(user.item_id)
72:     target_old_item_preference = target.wants_item?(target.item_id)
73:     target_diff = target_new_item_preference - target_old_item_preference
74:     target_diff = 0 if !target.item_active?
75:     score += user_diff * 4
76:     score -= target_diff * 4
77:     # Don't prefer if user used this move in the last round
78:     score -= 15 if user.battler.lastMoveUsed &&
79:                    GameData::Move.exists?(user.battler.lastMoveUsed) &&
80:                    GameData::Move.get(user.battler.lastMoveUsed).function_code == move.function_code
81:     next score
82:   }
83: )

176: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("StartTargetCannotUseItem",
177:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
178:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if !target.item || !target.item_active?
179:     # NOTE: We won't check if the item has an effect, because if a Pokémon is
180:     #       holding an item, it probably does.
181:     item_score = target.wants_item?(target.item_id)
182:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if item_score <= 0   # Item has no effect or is bad
183:     score += item_score * 2
184:     next score
185:   }

191: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("StartNegateHeldItems",
192:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
193:     next if battle.field.effects[PBEffects::MagicRoom] == 1   # About to expire anyway
194:     any_held_items = false
195:     total_want = 0   # Positive means foes want their items more than allies do
196:     ai.each_battler do |b, i|
197:       next if !b.item
198:       # Skip b if its item is disabled
199:       if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
200:         # NOTE: We won't check if the item has an effect, because if a Pokémon
201:         #       is holding an item, it probably does.
202:         if battle.field.effects[PBEffects::MagicRoom] > 0
203:           # NOTE: Same as b.item_active? but ignoring the Magic Room part.
204:           next if b.effects[PBEffects::Embargo] > 0
205:           next if battle.corrosiveGas[b.index % 2][b.party_index]
206:           next if b.has_active_ability?(:KLUTZ)
207:         else
208:           next if !b.item_active?
209:         end
210:       end
211:       # Rate b's held item and add it to total_want
212:       any_held_items = true
213:       want = b.wants_item?(b.item_id)
214:       total_want += (b.opposes?(user)) ? want : -want
215:     end
216:     # Alter score
217:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if !any_held_items
218:     if battle.field.effects[PBEffects::MagicRoom] > 0
219:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if total_want >= 0
220:       score -= [total_want, -5].max * 4   # Will enable items, prefer if allies affected more
221:     else
222:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if total_want <= 0
223:       score += [total_want, 5].min * 4   # Will disable items, prefer if foes affected more
224:     end
225:     next score
226:   }
227: )

233:   proc { |move, user, ai, battle|

236:   }

238: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("UserConsumeBerryRaiseDefense2",
239:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
240:     # Score for raising the user's stat
241:     stat_raise_score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_move_effect_score("RaiseUserDefense2",
242:        0, move, user, ai, battle)
243:     score += stat_raise_score if stat_raise_score != Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
244:     # Score for the consumed berry's effect
245:     score += user.get_score_change_for_consuming_item(user.item_id, true)
246:     # Score for other results of consuming the berry
247:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
248:       # Prefer if user will heal itself with Cheek Pouch
249:       score += 8 if user.battler.canHeal? && user.hp < user.totalhp / 2 &&
250:                     user.has_active_ability?(:CHEEKPOUCH)
251:       # Prefer if target can recover the consumed berry
252:       score += 8 if user.has_active_ability?(:HARVEST) ||
253:                     user.has_move_with_function?("RestoreUserConsumedItem")
254:       # Prefer if user couldn't normally consume the berry
255:       score += 5 if !user.battler.canConsumeBerry?
256:       # Prefer if user will become able to use Belch
257:       score += 5 if !user.battler.belched? && user.has_move_with_function?("FailsIfUserNotConsumedBerry")
258:       # Prefer if user will benefit from not having an item
259:       score += 5 if user.has_active_ability?(:UNBURDEN)
260:     end
261:     next score
262:   }
263: )

273: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("AllBattlersConsumeBerry",
274:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
275:     # Score for the consumed berry's effect
276:     score_change = target.get_score_change_for_consuming_item(target.item_id, !target.opposes?(user))
277:     # Score for other results of consuming the berry
278:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
279:       # Prefer if target will heal itself with Cheek Pouch
280:       score_change += 8 if target.battler.canHeal? && target.hp < target.totalhp / 2 &&
281:                            target.has_active_ability?(:CHEEKPOUCH)
282:       # Prefer if target can recover the consumed berry
283:       score_change += 8 if target.has_active_ability?(:HARVEST) ||
284:                            target.has_move_with_function?("RestoreUserConsumedItem")
285:       # Prefer if target couldn't normally consume the berry
286:       score_change += 5 if !target.battler.canConsumeBerry?
287:       # Prefer if target will become able to use Belch
288:       score_change += 5 if !target.battler.belched? && target.has_move_with_function?("FailsIfUserNotConsumedBerry")
289:       # Prefer if target will benefit from not having an item
290:       score_change += 5 if target.has_active_ability?(:UNBURDEN)
291:     end
292:     score += (target.opposes?(user)) ? -score_change : score_change
293:     next score
294:   }
295: )

300: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("UserConsumeTargetBerry",
301:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
302:     next score if !target.item || !target.item.is_berry?
303:     next score if user.battler.unlosableItem?(target.item)
304:     next score if target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0
305:     next score if target.has_active_ability?(:STICKYHOLD) && !battle.moldBreaker
306:     # Score the user gaining the item's effect
307:     score += user.get_score_change_for_consuming_item(target.item_id)
308:     # Score for other results of consuming the berry
309:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
310:       # Prefer if user will heal itself with Cheek Pouch
311:       score += 8 if user.battler.canHeal? && user.hp < user.totalhp / 2 &&
312:                     user.has_active_ability?(:CHEEKPOUCH)
313:       # Prefer if user will become able to use Belch
314:       score += 5 if !user.battler.belched? && user.has_move_with_function?("FailsIfUserNotConsumedBerry")
315:       # Don't prefer if target will benefit from not having an item
316:       score -= 5 if target.has_active_ability?(:UNBURDEN)
317:     end
318:     # Score the target no longer having the item
319:     item_preference = target.wants_item?(target.item_id)
320:     no_item_preference = target.wants_item?(:NONE)
321:     score -= (no_item_preference - item_preference) * 3
322:     next score
323:   }
324: )

329: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureCheck.add("ThrowUserItemAtTarget",
330:   proc { |move, user, ai, battle|
331:     item = user.item
332:     next true if !item || !user.item_active? || user.battler.unlosableItem?(item)
333:     next true if item.is_berry? && !user.battler.canConsumeBerry?
334:     next true if item.flags.none? { |f| f[/^Fling_/i] }
335:     next false
336:   }
337: )
338: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveBasePower.add("ThrowUserItemAtTarget",
339:   proc { |power, move, user, target, ai, battle|
340:     next move.move.pbBaseDamage(power, user.battler, target.battler)
341:   }
342: )
343: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("ThrowUserItemAtTarget",
344:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
345:     case user.item_id
346:     when :POISONBARB, :TOXICORB
347:       score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_move_effect_against_target_score("PoisonTarget",
348:          score, move, user, target, ai, battle)
349:     when :FLAMEORB
350:       score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_move_effect_against_target_score("BurnTarget",
351:          score, move, user, target, ai, battle)
352:     when :LIGHTBALL
353:       score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_move_effect_against_target_score("ParalyzeTarget",
354:          score, move, user, target, ai, battle)
355:     when :KINGSROCK, :RAZORFANG
356:       score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_move_effect_against_target_score("FlinchTarget",
357:          score, move, user, target, ai, battle)
358:     else
359:       score -= target.get_score_change_for_consuming_item(user.item_id)
360:     end
361:     # Score for other results of consuming the berry
362:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
363:       # Don't prefer if target will become able to use Belch
364:       score -= 5 if user.item.is_berry? && !target.battler.belched? &&
365:                     target.has_move_with_function?("FailsIfUserNotConsumedBerry")
366:       # Prefer if user will benefit from not having an item
367:       score += 5 if user.has_active_ability?(:UNBURDEN)
368:     end
369:     # Prefer if the user doesn't want its held item/don't prefer if it wants to
370:     # keep its held item
371:     item_preference = user.wants_item?(user.item_id)
372:     no_item_preference = user.wants_item?(:NONE)
373:     score += (no_item_preference - item_preference) * 2
374:     next score
375:   }
376: )
